Painting FAQ

What preparation is included before painting?

Preparation may include protecting surfaces, patching drywall, sanding, caulking, priming and cleaning as needed for the project.

Do you paint occupied homes?

Yes. We plan work areas and daily cleanup to reduce disruption while the property remains occupied.
